findings.reason: the done-when's "so tests/test_browser_skip_is_not_vacuous.py keeps its meaning" is false, and the node cannot repair a failing test outside its scope, so §2 cannot reach green as written.
findings.text: §2 adds a Playwright clause reading `~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-*/chrome-headless-shell-linux64/chrome-headless-shell`, which exists on this host (verified: `/home/ITER/mcintos/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1243/chrome-headless-shell-linux64/chrome-headless-shell`); `tests/test_browser_skip_is_not_vacuous.py::test_the_guard_skips_and_names_the_binaries_without_a_browser` strips only `PATH` and asserts `installed_browser_or_skip()` raises `SkipTest`, so once the Playwright clause resolves the guard no longer skips and that test fails — yet §2's write paths (line 72) name only `tests/spa_browser_harness.py` and `tests/test_browser_harness_finds_playwright.py`, fencing the node out of the test its own change breaks

findings.reason: the node cannot establish its baseline with the command the done-when names, so a reduction "to 15 against 60" is measured against a population that command does not produce.
findings.text: §5's done-when targets "at most 15 sites ... against 60 on 2026-10-10" using `grep -rn -e inspect.getsource -e "__file__).read_text" tests/`, which yields 37 today (19 + 18) and also 37 at the health-review revision `4aca668a`; §1 repeats "60 sites in 40 files", and even the review report's own printed three-pattern command reproduces 37, not 60

findings.reason: the mechanism as written does not produce the measure its done-when asserts, so a worker driving `clone_matches` alone sees per-window matches (135,736) rather than the 202-into-40 population.
findings.text: §4's done-when says "`reckon/clones.py` over `tests/` reports at most 40 cross-file full-body helper pairs, against 202", but `reckon/clones.py` exposes only `clone_matches`/`promotion_clone_matches` (changed-functions-against-corpus matchers) and no whole-tree pair-census entry point; the 202 came from the health-review `clones_driver.py` plus `clones_analyse.py` filtering `containment == 1.0` to cross-file pairs, a filter the plan never names

findings.reason: a reader of the-suite-is-green-at-head cannot see the incoming work this plan creates for it, so the handoff the sections assert is invisible on the plan graph.
findings.text: §1 states the-suite-is-green-at-head owns keeping the suite green and §2 says the browser tests that then fail are "recorded on the-suite-is-green-at-head", which is this plan feeding findings to that plan (an `informs` edge); the plan declares no `informs`/`gates` relationship, only `plan-after`
